NONE: › (of actions) having no effect or achieving nothing
（行動）無作用的；無效的；不成功的

example: Attempts to get supplies to the region are futile because troops will not allow the aid convoy to enter the city.
往該地區運送物資的努力失敗了，因爲軍方不允許救援物資護送隊進城。
It's completely futile trying to reason with him - he just won't listen.
跟他講道理一點用都沒有——他就是不聽。
All my attempts to cheer her up proved futile.
我想讓她快活起來，但所有的努力都白費了。

NONE: › a type of mattress, originally from Japan, that can be rolled up, or a bed or seat made from such a mattress
蒲團；床墊
› a type of football played between two teams of five players on a hard surface and in which each team can use an unlimited number of substitutes
五人制足球
B1 a period of time that is to come
將來，未來，今後
A2 language the form of a verb that you use when talking about something that will happen or exist
（文法上的）將來時，將來式
C: C2 [ C ] what will happen to someone or something in the time that is to come
S or U: B1 [ S or U ] the chance of continuing success or existence for something
成功的可能性；繼續存在的可能性
B1 used at the beginning or end of a sentence in which there is a decision about a plan of action or a warning
（用於表示決定或警告的句子的句首或句尾）今後，從今往後

NONE: › agreements for the buying and selling of goods, in which the price is agreed before a particular future time at which the goods will be provided
期貨；期貨交易
B1 happening or existing in the future
未來的，將來的
› language The future form of a verb is used when talking about something that will happen or exist.
（文法中）將來時的，將來式的
› used when you tell someone something so that it will be known about and can be used in the future
以後要記住
› in order to be used or looked at some time in the future
以備未來使用

example: Sometimes I worry about the future.
有時候我擔心未來。
I wonder what the future holds for (= what will happen to) you and me.
我不知道你和我未來會怎麽樣。
I'm sure at some point in the future I'll want a baby.
我確信在未來的某個時候我會想要一個孩子。
We need to plan for the future.
我們需要計劃一下未來。
Do you plan to leave New York in the distant future or the near future?
你計劃在較遠的將來還是不久之後離開紐約？
I can see those two getting married in the not too distant future (= quite soon).
我看得出那兩個人不久就會結婚的。
In the sentence "He will study" the verb phrase "will study" is in the future.
句子 He will study 中，動詞片語 will study 用的是將來式。
Torn apart by war, its economy virtually destroyed, this country now faces a very uncertain future.
經過戰爭的蹂躪，這個國家的經濟遭到了根本性的破壞，前途未蔔。
She's a very talented young singer, Mike, and I personally think she's got a great future ahead of her!
麥克，她是個非常有天賦的年輕歌手，我個人認爲她的前途一片光明。
The future isn't looking too rosy for these companies.
這些公司的前途看起來不怎麽妙。
With falling audiences, the future of this theatre is in doubt.
隨著觀眾數量的下降，這家劇院的未來堪憂。
Could you be more careful in future?
你以後能不能仔細些？
In future I won't bother asking him out anywhere if he's just going to complain that he's bored!
從今往後如果他抱怨說無聊，我不會再邀他出去玩。
In future I'm going to check every single piece of work that you do!
今後我要檢查你做過的每項工作。
the futures market
期貨市場
She works in futures.
她從事期貨交易。
Of course we'll keep you up to date about any future developments.
當然我們會讓你知道將來最新的進展情況。
There's an old superstition that young girls going to bed on this night dream of their future husbands.
有這麽一種古老的迷信，認爲年輕姑娘們這天晚上睡覺會夢到未來的丈夫。
How do you say that in the future tense?
那句話用將來式怎麽說？
For future reference, could you use the headed paper for any correspondence that leaves this office?
以後要記住，從這個辦公室發出去的信都要用帶有抬頭的信紙。
I filed the documents away for future reference.
我把文件歸檔，以備未來之用。

NONE: › to design software, a computer, etc. so that it can still be used in the future, even when technology changes
使…不過時（設計軟體、電腦等時使其面向未來，令其在技術不斷發展的情況下也不會過時）
› Future-proof software, computer equipment, etc. is designed so that it can still be used even when technology changes.
（軟體、電腦設備等）面向未來的，防過時的

example: Here are some tips for future-proofing your computer network.
這裡有一些小訣竅，能使你的電腦網路不會過時。
Is it possible to build a future-proof PC?
有可能製作一臺永不過時的個人電腦嗎？

NONE: › a new way of thinking in the arts that started in the 1920s and 1930s that tried to express through a range of art forms the characteristics and images of the modern age, such as machines, speed, movement, and power
未來主義
› strange and very modern, or intended or seeming to come from some imagined time in the future
未來派的；超前新奇的

example: A futuristic car was on display at the auto show.
車展上展出了一輛超前新奇的汽車。
Her latest novel is a futuristic thriller, set some time in the late 21st century.
她的新書是一部未來派風格的驚險小說，背景設定於21世紀後期的某個時間。
